source: CDC, Measles Cases and Outbreaks (National Center for Immunization and Respiratory Diseases)
method: Read through a real browser on 2026-09-09; www.cdc.gov refuses non-browser fetchers. The page states full-year confirmed case totals for the two most recent complete years and a year-to-date total for the current year. These are the measles program's confirmed-case counts, which CDC itself cites as the annual totals; they can differ by a handful of cases from the NNDSS annual table once that table is finalized (the program's 2019 total is 1,274 against the NNDSS 1,275).

quotes.2024: For comparison, 16 outbreaks were reported during 2024 and 69% of cases (198 of 285) were outbreak-associated.
quotes.2025: For the full year of 2025, a total of 2,289 confirmed* measles cases were reported in the United States.
quotes.2026: As of September 3, 2026, 3,134 confirmed* measles cases were reported in the United States in 2026.
